name: What are the best types of lights for under-cabinet task lighting?

mainEntity.name: What are the best types of lights for under-cabinet task lighting?

acceptedAnswer.text: For under-cabinet task lighting, LED strip lights, puck lights, and linear fluorescent fixtures are popular choices. LED strips offer continuous, even light distribution and are energy-efficient with a long lifespan. Puck lights provide focused spots of light, often used for accenting or in smaller sections. Linear fluorescent fixtures offer bright, even illumination but are less common now due to LED advancements. Consider dimmable options for flexibility and choose a color temperature that complements your kitchen's aesthetic, typically 3000K to 4000K for a warm to neutral white light.
acceptedAnswer.description: LED strip lights are ideal for continuous, energy-efficient illumination. Puck lights offer focused spots, while linear fluorescent fixtures provide bright, even light.
